knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Equal totals show the debits and credits were entered equally, but a wrong account still balances, so the trial balance does not prove each account is right.
Four of twelve months have passed by 31 December (September to December), so one third of the $1,200 premium, which is $400, is expensed and prepaid insurance is reduced by the same amount.
Closing resets income, expense and drawings accounts to nil, so only asset, liability and equity accounts carry balances after closing.

practicalCriteria: Learner prepares an unadjusted trial balance and three adjusting entries from a supplied set of ledger balances (accrued wages, prepaid insurance and depreciation), and the adjusted trial balance totals agree.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Unadjusted and adjusted trial balances saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner closes drawings as an expense
Learner treats a tax treatment of depreciation, bad debts or prepayments as settled without checking it
